stateHelp: Reuses semantic Final, Memory Keeper, reviewed Diff and State Commit. Each gate is separate; models and fact candidates cannot commit automatically.
final: Semantic Final for these exact bytes
diffHelp: Review every quotation, before value and after value. Inferences, plans and counterfactuals are not committed events.
confirmState: I reviewed all changes and evidence and explicitly authorize committing this exact State Diff.
nextContext: Rebuild and review the next chapter Writer Context after commit. Existing approved packets expire when State changes; unknown dates and future events remain isolated.
taskSaved: Task saved; details remain in the existing task manager.
commander: Planning model (does not grant file permissions)
worldFromDirector: Analyze this scene in the world lab
worldHandoffHelp: Bring back an explicitly selected hypothesis, review the new Writer Context, then resume this director task. Nothing becomes a committed fact.
retainCursor: Keep through cursor; rewrite the rest
retainHelp: Place the cursor at the end of the text to retain. Cancels the request, checkpoints the exact prefix and applies your new directions. Old text stays in version history.
retainMismatch: The draft changed. Select the retained boundary again.
keepRequired: Select the retained boundary and enter the continuation directions.
stateTime: End-of-chapter State time (author supplied, with timezone)
stateTimeHelp: Supply a conservative as-of anchor for completed events. Outline time is not adopted automatically, and this anchor does not claim simultaneous exact timing. Current baseline:
manualHelp: Only the author can decide manual conditions. Enter your basis and explicitly accept or reject. Solver results and AI opinions do not grant approval.
manualStale: The experiment or rules changed. Prior decisions no longer apply. Freeze and run a new version.
privateHistory: Include this project’s assistant chats, roleplay sessions and creative task history (private)
backupScope: Only the current project is included. Persona permissions and model preferences restore to the new project without overwriting global settings. API keys, login credentials, Core and private character models are excluded. Restored tasks never resume automatically.
